summary: Ported the Conduit RealWorld API (EF Core 10) to run on either SQL Server or PostgreSQL behind a single config switch. Provider is now resolved once at startup from Data:Provider (SqlServer|PostgreSql, fail-fast on missing/invalid, no default engine) via a DatabaseProvider enum + accessor seam, with named connection strings AppDb_SqlServer and AppDb_PostgreSql configured side by side as placeholders. Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL was added; the unused SQLite engine wiring/packages were removed per the switch contract. Per-engine physical model forks (Npgsql only): UTC timestamps map to timestamp with time zone, and identity string columns (Username, Email, Slug, TagId) use a case-insensitive ICU collation for parity with SQL Server's CI collation. No raw SQL, ADO.NET, or stored procedures existed, so queries, entities, and SQL Server behavior are unchanged. Build clean (0 warnings), 16/16 integration tests pass on the InMemory provider; live SQL Server/PostgreSQL verification is flagged as an explicit gap (R11).
